The '''launch codes''', are necessary to access the elevator to the [[spaceship]]'s landing pad. They are acquired from [[Hornfels]], located up at the [[Observatory]].

After the first [[death]], the player retains knowledge of the codes. The first time the player dies in the loop, [[Slate]] will remind the player to the codes, then assume they have been inhaling too many fumes when the player says they already have them.

The codes are shown in-game as '''- - | - . . | - .'''

The launch codes spell "'''MDN'''" when translated from morse code .
